answer: For a haven poll on tide protection for the reef, officials lock $10 per ballot and randomly summon 10% of voters to an in-person audit. They count funded ballots and reject unfunded ones. Summoned voters who attend recover their deposits; officials forfeit deposits for no-shows and refund all others. Extra ballots tie up $10 each and risk forfeiture. Paid proxies can attend, and the audit can penalize genuine voters.
